question: The value of ((2020)/(2000))⁻²⁰⁰⁸ times ((2020)/(2000))²⁰⁰⁸times 2020 is:
solution:
Given:

(2020/2000)-2008 × (2020/2000)2008 × 2020

Formula Used:

am × an = am + n

Calculation:

Combine the powers of (2020/2000):

(2020/2000)-2008 × (2020/2000)2008 = (2020/2000)-2008 + 2008

(2020/2000)0 = 1

Now multiply the result by 2020:

1 × 2020 = 2020

The value of the expression is 2020.
